title_en: VEHICLE CONTROL AND INTERFACE WITH MOBILE DEVICE
abstract_en: A vehicle control system is described herein that uses a mobile computing device to interface with a remotely operated vehicle. The system provides a link between an existing device with Wi-Fi or other networking to a radio controlled vehicle. The system provides an application that runs on the mobile device and uses the networking facilities of the device to send control information to receiving hardware attached to the vehicle. The system may also provide a receiving module that interfaces with an existing flight control module of the vehicle to allow a vehicle that was not specifically designed to be controlled by a mobile phone to have this capability added. Thus an operator unsophisticated in the flight of remote control vehicles can show up to a job site, deploy the vehicle, and have his or her mobile device guide the vehicle through a flight pattern that captures useful measurements.

title_en: Efficient water-air amphibious unmanned aerial vehicle and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an efficient water-air amphibious unmanned aerial vehicle and a control method thereof. The unmanned aerial vehicle adopts a 4 + 2 power layout, two motors are used in the front direction, and four motors are used in the longitudinal direction. The vector thrust device is used for assisting the unmanned aerial vehicle to submerge and float, the power transmission device is used for solving the problem of unstable water entering and exiting power of the unmanned aerial vehicle, stable water entering and exiting and underwater work which can only be achieved through a large number of devices are replaced with a small number of mechanical structures, meanwhile, the working efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicle in air and water is guaranteed, and underwater free navigation is achieved. The method has important innovative significance on underwater organism monitoring, resource exploration and sea area safety maintenance.

title_en: Ship course obstruction warning transport
abstract_en: An unmanned aquatic surface vehicle 104 for detecting and locating hazards is disclosed. The vehicle includes a propulsion system (304, Fig 3) configured to impart a propulsive force to the vehicle and a steering system (306, Fig 3) configured to impart a change in the direction of travel of the vehicle. A navigation system (316, Fig 3) may be included to detect the location, direction, and motion of the vehicle. A hazard detection system (308, Fig 3) is configured to detect and locate at least one of a subsurface, surface or above-water hazard. A communications device (310, Fig 3) configured to transmit hazard data associated with a detected hazard to a remote receiver. A control station (202, Fig 2) is able to control the vehicle, and receive and display information about hazards detected by the unmanned aquatic surface vehicle.

title_en: Forward deployed sensor system
abstract_en: Generally, the present disclosure relates to a forward deployed sensor system or, in a specific embodiment, a forward deployed radar (FDR) system. The forward deployed sensor system includes a radar system and may also include other types of sensors such as optical sensors, acoustic sensors including sonar, and electromagnetic sensors. Further, the forward deployed sensor system may also include a communication system such as a full spectrum receiver/transmitter, a ship to ship relay transponder, a satellite communication system, and global positioning system (GPS) capability. The forward deployed sensor system is able to detect objects in the air, on the sea, and underwater, and communicate such detection to a ship, submarine, aircraft, satellite, or other remote location. Such systems may be used to augment the protection of shipping lanes by military or security forces to allow for peaceful commerce and utility of the sea by all nations.

title_en: Undersea free vehicle and components
abstract_en: A free vehicle suitable to serve as a platform to carry a variety of equipment to the ocean floor, actuate devices at the floor and at intermediate points on the way to and returning from the ocean floor is described. The free vehicle includes standardized power, control electronics, navigation equipment and mechanical release mechanisms that can be used in conjunction with custom experiments. Exemplary experiments include sensors and sampling equipment used for deep-sea exploration. The free vehicle platform provides for scalable designs to meet scientific needs and surface vessel constraints.

title_en: DEVICE FOR INSPECTION OF HYDRAULIC STRUCTURES
abstract_en: FIELD: underwater technology.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to the field of underwater technology used for the survey, maintenance and periodic inspection of the surfaces of hydraulic structures, namely, remote-controlled underwater robotic systems that provide high-precision survey, including the use of non-destructive testing methods, profiling underwater extended and located in the zone of variable water level object surfaces. The device for inspection of hydraulic structures additionally contains a unit for ultrasonic testing of structural strength, a unit for monitoring angular values, a video camera, an ultrasonic underwater thickness gauge, a unit for underwater measurement of electrode potentials, a navigation instrument assembly placed on a movable carrier, as well as a compass connected to the unit for recording readings, an inclinometer , connected to the readings recording unit, stopwatch connected to the readings recording unit, depth gauge connected to the readings recording unit; a video data storage module placed on a floating buoy, connected to the output of the control unit, designed to store video files of a video camera; at the same time, the cable line is additionally equipped with an adjustable electric drive placed on a floating buoy and connected to the output by a control unit.EFFECT: increasing the reliability of determining the technical condition of building structures of hydraulic structures of various functional purposes based on monitoring physical parameters and adding new functional options - ultrasonic strength control of building structures, determining deviations between structures and measuring gaps between structures of hydraulic structures, determining the thickness of metal structures under water, determining electrode corrosion potential of metal structures, survey of the bottom of water areas.1 cl, 4 dwg

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle control method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle control method and system, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the initial alignment of an underwater attitude of an unmanned aerial vehicle when the unmanned aerial vehicle is in a static state, and determining an initial attitude angle of the unmanned aerial vehicle; and when a remote control instruction is received, performing real-time attitude change on the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the initial attitude angle based on the remote control instruction and sensor data of the unmanned aerial vehicle acquired in real time. Through a cooperative mechanism of initial alignment and real-time adjustment, the unmanned aerial vehicle can maintain consistency and stability of attitude control in a cross-medium switching or complex water area environment, operation interruption caused by initial reference drift or insufficient dynamic response is avoided, and then the task reliability of the unmanned aerial vehicle in a composite complex scene is improved.

title_en: Multi-sensing robot for underwater detection and use method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-sensing robot for underwater detection and a use method. The multi-sensing robot comprises a shell, a wheel foot module, a lifting module, a detection module and a control module. The shell is a square closed shell of which the center is provided with a circular cavity; the wheel foot module comprises at least two pairs of wheel foot assemblies, and each pair of wheel foot assemblies are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the shell. The lifting module is arranged in the circular cavity of the shell; the control module comprises an MCU unit, and the MCU unit is in communication connection with the wheel foot module, the lifting module, the detection module and the main control end and used for controlling the wheel foot module and the lifting module according to a control instruction of the main control end and information provided by the detection module. According to the amphibious robot, through cooperation of the wheel foot module, the lifting module and the gravity center adjusting module, posture adjustment, flexible movement and high-speed cruising of the robot in water can be achieved, self-camouflage can be achieved in the underwater cruising process, and the concealment is improved.

title_en: Micro Buoy Robot having attitude control system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a micro buoy robot which is located on the water to acquire and transmit underwater information. The micro buoy robot having an attitude control system includes: a lower body part (10) forming a certain storage space therein and forming an outer appearance; an upper body part (20) provided at a side of the lower body part (10) and coupled to the lower body part (10) to shield the inside; a pair of body propellers (30) provided in the lower body part (20) to provide propulsion; an information collection part (40) provided at a side of the lower body part (20) and composed of an obstacle avoidance sonar (OAS) capable of acquiring acoustic information or a camera for collecting acoustic and image information; a rotary rack/pinion drive part (50) provided in the storage space formed inside the upper part (20) and the lower part and controlling attitude of the micro buoy robot with operation of pinion/rack gears controlled by driving of a motor; and an integration control part (60) controlling the driving of the motor, operation of the sonar, and driving of the rotary rack/pinion drive part (50) and the body propellers (30).

title_en: Underwater tunnel detection device
abstract_en: An underwater tunnel detection device comprises a rack, a position adjusting assembly and a visual identification assembly. The rotary adjusters are respectively mounted at the front and rear positions of the rack; the front sail and the rear sail are respectively and correspondingly arranged at the front and rear positions of the rack; the rotating end of the rotating adjuster is connected to the front sail or the rear sail and used for driving the front sail or the rear sail to conduct angle adjustment. The storage rack is installed in the middle of the rack and provided with a water cavity and a battery cavity. The water cavity is used for controlling buoyancy through drainage and water storage; the battery cavity is used for installing a power supply; according to the scheme, the underwater tunnel detection device is used for underwater exploration and detection, can autonomously work underwater through the moving structure and the visual function of the underwater tunnel detection device, obtains underwater environment information, provides power through water flow impact, starts monitoring work after equipment is powered on, achieves unpowered long-distance operation, and improves the working efficiency. The problems that existing underwater operation equipment cannot autonomously perform long-distance operation due to insufficient power and underwater detection is limited are solved.
note: tunnel detection rack moved by sails; propulsion unclear

title_en: Movable bridge and dam area ship navigation front early warning facility and working mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile bridge and dam area ship navigation front early warning facility and a working mode. The facility is provided with a 5G communication module, an ultrasonic anemograph,a ship body scanner and a visibility meter and is installed on an overwater installation frame, and a single-beam depth finder and a water flow meter are installed on an underwater installation frame; wherein the floating body attitude measuring instrument, the solar cell panel and the mounting rack are fixed on the floating body, and the lithium battery pack, the main control processing computerand the AIS transceiver are mounted in the floating body cabin. Navigation safety detection, ship navigation safety result judgment and ship navigation safety early warning can be carried out on passing ships in a bridge and dam area, meanwhile, the solar cell panel, the lithium battery pack and the 5G communication module are arranged, extra power supply cables and communication cables do not need to be laid in use, and the facility can be deployed in any water area of the bridge and dam area; and the position can be moved according to the requirements of a user. When the facility is used, ship berthing is not needed, deployment is flexible, early warning is accurate, meanwhile, the structure is light, and convenience is provided for later equipment maintenance.

title_en: Method for remotely controlling unmanned aerial vehicle to detect shallow sea and pool bay underwater
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for remotely controlling an unmanned aerial vehicle to detect shallow sea and pool bay underwater, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle and an underwater sensingdevice. The method is characterized in that a nacelle is arranged at the abdomen of the unmanned aerial vehicle and is provided with a controllable take-up device for extending a net wire, the controllable take-up device winds the net wire, and the net wire is connected with the underwater sensing device; and the unmanned aerial vehicle needs to have a power that carry 3-5 kg, the carrying weightcomprises the underwater sensing device and the nacelle, and the nacelle is also provided with a transceiver and the controllable take-up device.

title_en: SUBSEA STRUCTURE CLEANING APPARATUS AND METHOD
abstract_en: The invention relates to an apparatus and related method for cleaning subsea structures at sea. In an embodiment, a hull cleaning system comprises a housing defining an interior void; a multifunction bar; a propulsion system; a power system; a positioning system; a water pump; a high flow manifold; a hull cleaner; and a suction device configured to selectively adhere the system to a hull. In another embodiment, a remotely operated work class vehicle, typically able to be deployed from any platform outfitted to accept its launch, recovery and support equipment, comprises a frame; an inspection sensor; a hydraulically powered, high pressure water jet pump; a predetermined tooling set connected to the housing; and a propulsion system, which includes a suction device, configured to propel the remotely operated work class vehicle about a surface.

title_en: System and method for point-to-point object matching and aiming
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are methods, devices, modules, and systems which may be employed for accurate targeting of objects. A method of point to point targeting may be implemented by systems with two or more sensors to locate an object and coordinate a handoff between the two or more sensors. These methods, devices, modules, and systems may be used for automated crop cultivation or maintenance. Devices disclosed herein may be configured to locate, identify, and autonomously target a weed with a beam, such as a laser beam, which may burn or irradiate the weed. The methods, devices, modules, and systems may be used for agricultural crop management or for at-home weed control.

title_en: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR RETROACTIVELY INSTALLING SENSORS ON MARINE ELEMENTS
abstract_en: Sensors, including fiber optic sensors and their umbilicals, are mounted on support structures designed to be retro-fitted to in-place structures, including subsea structures. The sensor support structures are designed to monitor structure conditions, including strain, temperature, and in the instance of pipelines, the existence of production slugs. Moreover the support structures are designed for installation in harsh environments, such as deep water conditions using remotely operated vehicles.

title_en: Amphibious detection robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of detection equipment and particularly relates to an amphibious detection robot. The robot is suitable for the two environments of water and land, free travelling on the land and underwater can be achieved, detection of the water surface and the water bottom can further be achieved, and SLAM on the land, on the water surface and at the water bottom is achieved. According to the robot, a sealed waterproof shell is integrally formed through a machine shell, a front end cover and a rear end cover. Four driving wheels are mounted outside the sealed shell. Each driving wheel is provided with a motor which is arranged in the sealed shell. A fixed chassis is mounted in the sealed shell. Sonar, a Raspberry Pi and an ultra-distance transmission module Xbee-pro used for data transmission are mounted on the chassis. An ROS operation system is transplanted in the Raspberry Pi, a SLAM algorithm is set in the Raspberry Pi, target detection and information collection can be achieved, and SLAM is completed autonomously. The amphibious detection robot provided by the invention has the advantages of being high in operation ability, high in intelligent degree, good in airtightness and the like.

title_en: Intelligent obstacle avoidance system of underwater propeller and control method of intelligent obstacle avoidance system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater robots, and discloses an underwater propeller intelligent obstacle avoidance system and a control method thereof, and the system comprises an environment collection module, an obstacle fitting module, a path generation module, a response duration calculation module and a path optimization selection module. The environment acquisition module acquires environment images, ultrasonic waves and water flow information; the obstacle fitting module establishes an obstacle distribution model based on the image and ultrasonic information; the path generation module generates a feasible path based on a model and a planning algorithm; the response duration calculation module calculates the time required for adjusting to the path starting point based on the dynamic model; and the path optimization selection module selects an optimal path based on a comprehensive evaluation strategy of the response duration, the obstacle avoidance capability and the energy consumption and outputs the optimal path to the driving module. According to the invention, multi-source information can be fused, water flow and dynamic constraints are considered, and safe, efficient and low-consumption intelligent obstacle avoidance is realized.

title_en: Underwater target cooperative positioning method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle topology control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of underwater target positioning, and discloses an underwater target cooperative positioning method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle topology control, and the method comprises the steps: constructing an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, and achieving the topological reconstruction of an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster structure through a virtual force topology control algorithm; performing preprocessing and time synchronization on the signals received by each unmanned aerial vehicle of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster so as to calculate an accurate time delay inequality; calculating the specific position coordinates of the underwater target according to the underwater target signals received by the unmanned aerial vehicles and the calculated time delay inequality; compared with a traditional scheme, the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster is dynamically deployed in a self-organized and self-adaptive mode through the virtual force topology so as to ensure stable communication of the cluster structure and expand the sensing coverage range, and the method has the advantages of self-adaptive adjustment and control, good communication robustness and high positioning precision; and underwater collaborative search and accurate positioning of the unmanned system can be realized.

title_en: Water depth measurement system and method for high-density navigation impeding area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water depth measurement system for a high-density navigation impeding area, and the system comprises an unmanned plane platform which is used for providing a carrying platform, a power support, GNSS data, attitude data and a view field picture in front of flight, and is also used for adjusting a flight path according to the judgment condition of an identification result; the connecting and fixing device is used for connecting and fixing the unmanned aerial vehicle platform and the water depth measurement module; the water depth measuring module is used for measuring water depth data in real time to obtain instantaneous water depth data; the water depth measurement industrial personal computer is used for calculating a final water depth result according to the GNSS data, the attitude data and the instantaneous water depth data; and the edge calculation box is used for reasoning according to the obtained water surface image in front of flight and outputting a recognition result. The invention further discloses a water depth measurement method for the high-density navigation impeding area. According to the invention, the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle is adopted to drive water depth measurement, and a camera monitoring intelligent obstacle identification and obstacle crossing system design is adopted, so that the possibility of being interfered by water obstacles is fundamentally avoided.

title_en: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR UTILITY POWER LINES VEGETATION PROXIMITY MONITORING AND CONTROLLING
abstract_en: Systems and methods for utility infrastructure condition monitoring, detection, and response are disclosed. One exemplary system includes a sensor package and a monitoring and control module. The sensor package includes a plurality of sensors such as, for example, an image sensor, a video sensor, and a LiDAR sensor. The sensors may each be configured to capture data indicative of one or more conditions (e.g., an environmental condition, a structural condition, etc.) in the vicinity of the utility infrastructure. The monitoring and control includes a detection module and an alert module. The detection module is configured to receive data captured by each sensor and, based on the captured data, determine one or more conditions in the vicinity of the utility infrastructure. The detection module may be configured to then, based on the determined conditions, provide an alert for the condition using the alert module. Sensor Data Processing to Vegetation Vegetation System Scan classify and Proximity Management and Data measure, terrain, Analysis, Work and Data Collection vegetation, Notification Management structures and and Database power lines.
