title_en: Heterogeneous communication cascaded remote controllable seabed observation system and data transmission method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heterogeneous communication cascaded remote controllable seabed observation system and a data transmission method thereof. The system comprises distributed monitoring nodes, AUV mobile monitoring nodes, a relay transmission module and a shore-based receiving system. The relay transmission module comprises a bottom-layer base station, a buoyancy self-balancing adjustment intermediate base station and a double-satellite backup controllable two-way communication base station which are sequentially connected through a zero-buoyancy coaxial cable from bottom to top. The relay transmission module has two working modes, namely a seabed communication mode and a sea surface communication mode. In the submarine communication mode, the double-satellite backup controllable two-way communication base station dives to a specified depth below the sea surface. And in the sea surface communication mode, the double-satellite backup controllable two-way communication base station floats to the sea surface. The invention provides a seabed observation local area network with remotely controllable monitoring strategies and working parameters, sea-air cross-medium communication is realized through multiple cascade links, and the working parameters of distributed monitoring nodes and mobile monitoring AUVs are remotely controlled.

title_en: Components formed from antifouling polymers
abstract_en: An apparatus for use in a subsea location comprises a component formed from a polymer combined with a marine growth inhibitor. The polymer is preferably a thermoplastics material and may be semi-crystalline polyphenylene sulphide, polyoxymethylene, or polyetheretherketone, each polymer being combined with a reinforcement material. The reinforcement material may be glass fibre, aramid fibre, carbon fibre or stainless steel strands. The inhibitor is typically a chemical salt, such as a metallic or inorganic salt. In a preferred embodiment, the apparatus is a subsea electrical connector, a subsea fibre optic connector, a hydraulic communication connector or a remotely operated vehicle (ROV) intervention panel. A method of manufacturing the component is also disclosed, which comprises the steps of combining the polymer and the inhibitor and molding the mixture to form the component.

title_en: UNDERWATER OBJECT DETECTION SYSTEM AND METHOD THE SAME
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system and method for detecting an underwater object are provided to prevent collision between ships by successively detecting obstacles above or below sea level in front of a ship. CONSTITUTION: An underwater object detecting system(100) includes a first detecting unit(110), a second detecting unit(120), a display unit(130), and a control unit(140). The first detecting unit detects an underwater object. The second detecting unit grasps information of the underwater object. The display unit displays the underwater object. If the first detecting unit detects the underwater object, the control unit operates the second detecting unit and transmits the information of the underwater object grasped by the second detecting unit to the display unit. [Reference numerals] (110) First detecting unit; (120) Second detecting unit; (130) Display unit; (140) Control unit

title_en: Robot suitable for water environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a robot suitable for a water environment, and belongs to the technical field of ocean engineering. The technical problems that a robot is small in underwater detection range, poor in practicability and the like are solved. The robot comprises a main body module capable of ascending and descending in water, a first rod body and a second rod body which are perpendicular to each other are inserted into the main body module, a plurality of guide wheels are arranged on the upper side of the main body module, a first belt wheel and a second belt wheel are arranged at the two ends of the upper side of the first rod body correspondingly, and a first plate body and a second plate body are arranged at the two ends of the lower side of the first rod body correspondingly; a third belt wheel and a fourth belt wheel are arranged at the two ends of the upper side of the second rod body correspondingly, a third plate body and a fourth plate body are arranged at the two ends of the lower side of the second rod body correspondingly, and the first belt wheel, the second belt wheel, the third belt wheel, the fourth belt wheel and the guide wheels are sleeved with a transmission belt; the first belt wheel, the second belt wheel, the third belt wheel and the fourth belt wheel are respectively connected with first motors; and the first plate body, the second plate body, the third plate body and the fourth plate body are respectively connected with second motors. The robot can transversely move and ascend and descend in water, the detection range is wide, and practicability is high.

title_en: DEEP-SEA TOPOGRAPHY AND TERRAIN UNITED MATCHING AIDED NAVIGATION POSITIONING SYSTEM AND METHOD
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a deepâ_x0080__x0094_sea topography and terrain united. matching aided. navigation. positioning systenl and. method. The system. includes a underwater topography and terrain basic database unit, an inertial navigation unit, a bathymetry side scan 5 sonar (BSSS), an underwater topography and terrain united matching unit and a combined navigation information fusion unit which are arranged inside a deepâ_x0080__x0094_sea vehicle; the underwater topography and terrain united matching unit is connected to the underwater topography and terrain. basic database unit, the inertial lO navigation unit, the BSSS and the combined navigation information fusion unit; and the combined navigation information fusion unit is connected to the inertial navigation unit. The present invention can improve the accuracy of underwater navigation positioning and achieve deepâ_x0080__x0094_sea accurate matching navigation l5 positioning.

title_en: SELF-PROPELLED BUOY FOR MONITORING UNDERWATER OBJECTS
abstract_en: Abstract Various embodiments of the invention provide a buoy and system for monitoring divers and other underwater objects. In many embodiments, the buoy has capabilities to monitor a diver, obtain position information about the diver and use that information to move itself to an effective range for continued monitoring. The buoy can connect and communicate with a communication device attached to a diver to communicate, position, biometric and other data. In one embodiment, the buoy comprises a propulsion system for propelling the buoy, an acoustic communication module for communicating with the diver and a propulsion controller for controlling the propulsion system to move to the effective range. Other embodiments provide a power generation system using a power generating buoy comprising an inertial weight, an energy converter and a connecting linkage. The system may comprise a single or multiple buoys and can include an electrical storage such as an electrical battery.

title_en: High-stability underwater detection towing system based on active and passive cooperative compensation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater detection, and discloses a high-stability underwater detection towing system based on active and passive cooperative compensation, which comprises an overwater mother ship, an electric winch arranged on the overwater mother ship, a first towing cable, a weight buffer, a second towing cable and a detection towed body, one end of the first towing cable is connected with the electric winch, and the other end is connected with the ballasting buffer; one end of the second towing cable is connected with the ballasting buffer, and the other end is connected with the detection towed body. According to the invention, stable carrying and high-precision data acquisition of underwater detection equipment can be realized, and multi-scene underwater detection requirements are met.

title_en: RIB/CRRC COMMON OPERATION APPARATUS OF AUTOMATIC UNMANNED VEHICLE OF MINESWEEPERS AND RIB/CRRC RIGID-HULLED INFLATABLE BOAT/COMBAT RAPID RUBBER CRAFT
abstract_en: Disclosed is a common operation apparatus of an automatic uncrewed vehicle of a minesweeper and an RIB/CRRC, comprising: a display for displaying the position information of an automatic uncrewed vehicle, a minesweeper and an RIB/CRRC; a communication module for performing communication with the automatic uncrewed vehicle, the minesweeper and the RIB/CRRC; a GPS module for receiving a GPS signal; and a positioning module for grasping position informatioqn using the GPS signal received in the GPS module and displaying the grasped position information through the display. In accordance with the above-mentioned common operation apparatus of an automatic uncrewed vehicle of a minesweeper and an RIB/CRRC, a relay function is provided to a neighboring minesweeper or a neighboring RIB/CRRC to enable an automatic uncrewed vehicle to be controlled remotely by a commander positioned remotely from the automatic uncrewed vehicle, thereby widening the operation radius of the automatic uncrewed vehicle and enhancing the ability to perform operations.

title_en: Underwater positioning subsurface buoy and underwater positioning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater positioning subsurface buoy and an underwater positioning system, which are applied to the technical field of underwater positioning and are used for solving the problems of low precision and single function of the underwater positioning subsurface buoy in the prior art. Specifically, a first signal receiving module is used for receiving a first signal sent by a target and a calibration signal sent by a response release module and sending the first signal and the calibration signal to a positioning electronic cabin, and a second signal receiving module is used for receiving a second signal sent by a mother ship and sending the second signal to the positioning electronic cabin; the positioning electronic cabin is used for processing the first signal to obtain time delay data, processing the calibration signal to realize subsurface buoy position calibration, processing the second signal to obtain instruction data, and executing corresponding operation according to the instruction data; the floating ball module is used for providing buoyancy for the underwater positioning subsurface buoy and providing a closed space for the positioning electronic cabin; the response release module is used for receiving an instruction sent by the mother ship, releasing the load module and sending a calibration signal to the first signal receiving module. Therefore, the precision of the underwater positioning subsurface buoy is improved, and the functions are rich.

title_en: Method for putting underwater navigation body on ocean semi-submersible platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for putting an underwater navigation body on an ocean semi-submersible platform, which can improve the test and test efficiency of the underwater navigation body on the sea. The device comprises a semi-submersible platform (1), a truss (2) with a guide rail, a linear motor (3), a driving vehicle (4), a hanging frame (5), an underwater navigation body (6) with a parachute and the like. The driving vehicle (4) loaded with the hanging frame (5) and the underwater navigation body (6) with the parachute starts to run in an acceleration mode from a static state along the truss (2) with the guide rail under the action of the linear motor (3), and when the throwing speed is reached, the hanging frame (5) is opened, and the underwater navigation body (6) with the parachute is thrown. According to the method for putting the underwater navigation body on the ocean semi-submersible platform, the experimental test of putting the underwater navigation body from the air to the water on the sea becomes convenient, a water entry point is easy to capture and measure, and the marine test efficiency of the underwater navigation body is improved.

title_en: REAL-TIME DATA COLLECTION AND COMMUNICATION SYSTEM FOR UNDERWATER ENVIRONMENT
abstract_en: The invention comprises a low-power method and system enabling data collection through sensors (1) placed on a device carried by individuals who can move in an underwater environment, and data transmission in an aquatic environment with the help of a transmitter furnished with a LED (6). The signal emitted from the LED is received by a photodiode (7) which is placed inside the water channel and demodulated to retrieve the data collected by the sensors. These data are transmitted, denoised and visualized on a computer (9) where they can be monitored in real time. The invented system is suitable for plural applications (e.g. batherÂ_x0092_s biometric parameters monitoring). It can also be applied to underwater robotic systems for collecting and monitoring data related to the aquatic environment.

title_en: Riserless modular subsea well intervention, method and apparatus
abstract_en: A subsea well intervention system that permits dynamic disconnection from subsea well intervention equipment without removing any of the equipment during a drive-off condition is provided. The system includes a blowout preventer module operatively connected to a subsea tree, a lubricator assembly attached to the blowout preventer module that provides access to the interior of the blowout preventer and the subsea tree by well intervention equipment, and an umbilical module including a fail-safe disconnect assembly. The fail-safe disconnect assembly is disconnected using hydraulic power provided by the control umbilical or by a remotely operated vehicle.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle assistance for submerged host vehicles
abstract_en: Methods, apparatus, systems, and articles of manufacture for unmanned vehicle assistance for submerged host vehicles are disclosed. An example apparatus includes at least one memory, machine readable instructions, and processor circuitry to at least one of instantiate or execute the machine readable instructions to determine an occurrence of a reduced operational capability of a vehicle, the vehicle at least partially submerged in a body of water, cause an unmanned vehicle (UV) to separate from the vehicle in response to the occurrence of the reduced operational capability, and determine positional information corresponding to the UV based on the UV reaching or departing a surface of the body of the water.

title_en: UNMANNED SUBMARINE APPARATUS
abstract_en: FIELD: transport. ^ SUBSTANCE: invention relates to ship building. Unmanned submarine (US) is intended for patrolling local underwater areas and primary inspection of detected objects. US comprises two propulsors, one representing variable-pitch cruising propeller with axis located along submarine waterline. Second propulsor actuates only at speed drop to very low magnitude and complete stoppage and represents variable-pitch propeller with axis located perpendicular to submarine waterline. At cruising speed, the latter does not work and represents x-like system of horizontal controlled rudders. ^ EFFECT: higher maneuverability at low speeds, reduced noise. ^ 7 dwg

title_en: Reservoir bank slope inspection method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle laser radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir bank slope inspection method and system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle laser radar, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle reservoir bank slope inspection, and the method comprises the following steps: 1, guaranteeing the normal working state of an unmanned aerial vehicle, starting the laser radar, connecting a ground GNSS reference station on the shore, calibrating the position of the unmanned aerial vehicle and a communication signal, an inspection area boundary and flight parameters are set; navigation data provided by a shoreside base station is utilized. According to the reservoir bank slope inspection method and system based on the unmanned aerial vehicle laser radar, the inspection efficiency is improved, and the endurance time is prolonged; the system is high in autonomy, reduces the labor cost, achieves the whole-course autonomous navigation, path optimization, obstacle avoidance and dynamic adjustment, does not need manual intervention, effectively reduces the workload and operation difficulty of inspection personnel, reduces the labor cost, improves the intelligent level of inspection tasks, and improves the autonomous adaptability of the unmanned aerial vehicle to complex terrains.

title_en: Submersible flood drainage robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a diving flood drainage robot which is divided into a front area, a middle cabin and a tail component, the front area comprises an intelligent control system, the intelligent control system integrates a plurality of sensor modules such as sonar, a camera, a flow meter and a water quality sensor which are all connected with a remote control terminal, and the remote control terminal is connected with the middle cabin. Real-time data transmission is realized; the middle cabin is a sealed cabin body and is of a titanium alloy framework and double-layer O-shaped ring sealing structure, and the pressure-resistant depth is larger than or equal to 50 m. The underwater three-dimensional map is constructed in real time through the SLAM mapping unit, a dynamic obstacle avoidance algorithm of the path planning unit is combined, the robot can autonomously avoid obstacles, the path adjustment response time is smaller than or equal to 50 ms, the flood drainage efficiency is improved by 40% or above, in addition, the cooperative control unit supports multi-machine task allocation, the task coverage rate during formation operation is improved by 60%, and the stability of formation operation is improved. The method is suitable for a complex water area scene, and achieves the collaborative optimization effect of efficient drainage and intelligent obstacle avoidance.

title_en: Sensor reading device and system
abstract_en: A device may include a wireless communication interface configured to communicate with a sensor reading device, receive a wake up command from the sensor reading device, and receive reflected energy from a sensor. The device may also include one or more processors, and one or more non-transitory computer readable media including instructions that, when executed by the one or more processors, perform or control performance of operations. The operations may include performing a wake up operation based on the wake up command from the sensor reading device, and recording the reflected energy from the sensor. The operations may further include generating a report regarding the reflected energy, and causing the wireless communication interface to transmit the report to the sensor reading device.

title_en: Modular autonomous surface robot of catamaran type
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an offshore robot which inspects the water quality and the environment on the inland waters and neighboring coasts, and comprises: two buoyancy bodies which are spaced apart at an interval corresponding to the width of an offshore deck, and have a propeller at the rear end; a first connecting frame which connects the buoyancy bodies to be assembled to each other to constitute a single vessel body, and has a base plate at an upper portion; a second connecting frame which is connected to the rear side of the first connecting frame to allow the buoyancy bodies to be assembled to each other; a vertical frame which is provided at the center of the second connecting frame, and of which an upper end is detachably provided with a transceiver which transmits and receives a signal for autonomous driving or remote control and a signal produced after the offshore environment is measured by means of various sensors, and a lower end is detachably provided with an underwater detection module to detect the topography and the environment of the underwaters; the underwater detection module which is detachably provided at a fixating frame of the buoyancy bodies, and detects the topography and the environment of the underwaters; a control module which is provided at the upper portion of the base plate to control the transceiver, the propeller, an FOG, the underwater detection module, a camera, a warning light, a GPS and a LiDAR; and a power source module which is provided at the upper portion of the base plate to supply power to the transceiver, the propeller, the FOG, the underwater detection module, the camera, the warning light, the GPS, the Lidar, and the control module. Therefore, according to the modular offshore robot of a catamaran type, monitoring of the offshore and underwater environment can be performed, such as investigation of the water quality environment state and the topography of the inland waters and neighboring costs, investigation of the offshore environment and an underwater/offshore structure, and acquisition of underwater sound information by means of remote control or autonomous driving. In addition, the present invention can be conveniently disassembled/assembled by two workers at minimum without additional equipment such as a crane, thereby facilitating ease in installation and maintenance and repair.

title_en: APPARATUS FOR PROVIDING INFORMATION RELATED MAINTENANCE OF UNMANNED AUTONOMOUS MOVING OBJECT AND UNMANNED AUTONOMOUS MOVING OBJECT HAVING THE SAME
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device mounted on an unmanned autonomous vehicle to provide maintenance-related information of the unmanned autonomous vehicle, the unmanned autonomous vehicle having the same, and a method for providing information thereof. According to an embodiment of the present invention, an apparatus for providing maintenance information includes an electronic configuration disposed on an unmanned autonomous moving object to provide maintenance-related information of the unmanned autonomous moving object. The electronic configuration includes: a processor including a learning model; and a communication module receiving state data from sensors measuring states of propulsion components of the unmanned autonomous moving object. The processor inputs the state data into the learning model to determine the possibility of failure for the propulsion components, determines whether maintenance is necessary based on the possibility of failure, determines the type of failure related to the propulsion component determined to require maintenance, and generates maintenance information based on the determination result.

title_en: Multi-rotor flying platform for water depth detection, detection system and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and particularly discloses a multi-rotor flying platform for water depth detection, a detection system and a detection method thereof, and a flying platform body comprises a cabin, a machine arm and a power system; the unmanned aerial vehicle further comprises a detection sonar transducer device, the lower end of the cabin is connected with the detection sonar transducer device through a rigid connecting device, and the detection system comprises a control module, a detection module, a GNSS system module, a ground station system and a flight control system. The detection method comprises the steps that the ground station end controls the multi-rotor flight platform load detection system to fly to a detected water area, the flight platform flies or hovers on the water surface, the transducer of the detection system stretches into the water surface, the water depth is calculated and detected through the sonar photoelectric conversion principle of the sonar transducer device, GNSS differential data is combined, and the detection precision is improved. Coordinates and elevation of a water bottom point can be obtained without being influenced by terrain and flow velocity of a water area, the defect of water depth measurement of a traditional unmanned depth measurement ship is overcome, and huge social benefits can be generated.

title_en: Subsea computed tomography system with flat panel detectors
abstract_en: A Computed Tomography (CT) system can be deployed by subsea vehicles such as remotely operated vehicles (ROVs) or by divers to perform CT inspections on a subsea structure. In embodiments, a marinized signal source and a marinized flat panel signal detector are positioned at a structure to be inspected subsea and possibly repositioned at different angles about the structure to acquire a series of 2D radiographic images which are then fed to a reconstruction algorithm that produces a 3D reconstructed volume of the structure being inspected.

title_en: Robot underwater positioning method and robot underwater positioning system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater positioning, in particular to a robot underwater positioning method and a robot underwater positioning system. The robot underwater positioning method comprises the following steps: receiving a signal representing the position of a robot relative to a water surface platform and output by a short baseline array mounted on the water surfaceplatform, and outputting first position information representing the position of the robot relative to the water surface platform; judging whether the water surface platform is located in a first areaor a second area or not; if the water surface platform is located in the first area, determining the position of the robotaccording to the first position information and the second position information; and if the water surface platform is located in the second area, determining the position of the robot according to the first position information, third position information and fourth position information. The robot underwater positioning method can improve the underwater positioning precision of the robot.

title_en: Cross-medium intelligent detection robot and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robot detection, in particular to a cross-medium intelligent detection robot and a working method thereof. The tracked robot and the quadruped robot perform land detection respectively, when the vision of the quadruped robot is blocked, current position information is recorded, the unmanned aerial vehicle is started to perform environment detection, path information is transmitted to the quadruped robot, and the quadruped robot performs obstacle avoidance according to the received path information; after land and air environment detection is completed, the quadruped robot is in butt joint with the unmanned aerial vehicle; when underwater detection is carried out, the quadruped robot after butt joint sinks into the water bottom, meanwhile, the unmanned aerial vehicle is started to be separated into water or air, and underwater propellers of the quadruped robot and the unmanned aerial vehicle are started to carry out underwater detection; and after underwater detection is completed, the quadruped robot and the unmanned aerial vehicle run to designated positions sent by the navigation system, and a detection task is completed. The method is wide in detection range.

title_en: Methods for vehicle propulsion
abstract_en: A field configurable autonomous vehicle includes modular elements and attachable components. The vehicle can be assembled from these modular elements and components to meet desired mission and performance characteristics without the need to purchase specially designed vehicles for each mission. The vehicle can include a modular propulsion system with magnetic drive.

title_en: Model monitoring for machine learning-based mapping systems
abstract_en: A system for monitoring performance of predictive models within subsea robotic mapping systems. A prediction unit 104 is coupled to a sensor assembly 106 configured to obtain measurements of a subsea environment 102. The prediction unit comprises a predictive model 108 operable to generate one or more features 110 from a signal 112 obtained from the sensors. A mapping unit 116 constructs a map 118 of the subsea environment based on data derived from the signal and/or the one or more features. A monitoring unit 120 determines a performance value associated with the one or more features generated by the predictive model and if the performance value does not satisfy a performance criterion (e.g. a threshold value), cause execution of an action to adjust operation of the mapping unit. The robot platform may comprise the mapping unit and the sensor assembly. The mapping unit may adjust a speed, movement or depth of the robotic platform. Alternatively the first predictive model may be by-passed so that the map is based on the data derived from the signal. Alternatively, the map may be based on features derived by a second predictive model 114.

title_en: Underwater equipment deploying and retrieving system and navigation equipment
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of navigation equipment. The invention provides an underwater equipment deploying and retrieving system and navigation equipment. The underwater equipment and system comprises a support assembly, a winch, a rope length calculating assembly and a controller. The winch comprises a first support, a second support, a roller and a mooring rope. The twoaxial ends of the roller are rotationally arranged on the first support and the second support correspondingly. The rope length calculating assembly is used for detecting the rotation of the roller in the rotation process of the roller; and the controller is connected to the rope length calculating assembly and used for calculating the length of the output cable according to a signal of the ropelength calculating assembly, so that lifting of the underwater equipment is conveniently controlled in time according to the length of the cable, and the problems that the cable is wound during deploying and the underwater equipment is touched and damaged due to the fact that the cable is too short during retrieving are avoided; according to the navigation equipment, the problems that the cable iswound due to the fact that the length of the underwater cable is too large during deploying and the underwater equipment is touched and damaged due to the fact that the cable is too short during retrieving can be avoided.

title_en: RAPID DEPLOYMENT SUBSEA CHEMICAL INJECTION SYSTEM
abstract_en: A rapid deployment, subsea chemical injection skid assembly includes a non-buoyant skid lowered on a weight bearing line from a surface vessel. The skid carries a chemical injection pump, as well as at least one chemical tank in fluid communication with the chemical injection pump. The skid assembly may include a recirculation/mixing system to limit separation or solids drop out of chemicals arising from medium or long-term storage of chemicals in the chemical tank,. The skid assembly may include a seawater filtration system to supply seawater for mixing with chemicals prior to injection. The skid assembly is operable by a separately tethered remotely operated vehicle.

title_en: Multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle and a control method. The multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a fuselage main body, a flight module, a positioning module, a draught and drainage module, a navigation module, an overwater and underwater communication module, a shooting module and a hiding module. The shooting module comprises a waterproof camera, and the overwater and underwater communication module comprises an underwater communication unit; the draught and drainage module is used for controlling the multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle to dive into the water and rise to the water surface from the water; the navigation module is used for controlling the multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle to navigate on the water surface or controlling the multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle to navigate underwater; the hiding module is used for hiding the multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle; the waterproof camera is used for shooting in the air, shooting on the land or shooting underwater when the multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle dives underwater; and the underwater communication unit is used for communicating with the outside under the water when the multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle is not underwater and dives into the water. The multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle provided by the invention can meet complex and changeable application environments and specific task requirements.

title_en: CONTROL SYSTEM, CONTROL METHOD, AND PROGRAM
abstract_en: [Problem] To enable improvement in performance of monitoring and tracking of a moving body moving in a marine area or the like by means of a plurality of unmanned vessels. [Solution] The present invention is a control system that detects an object by means of a plurality of unmanned vessels capable of navigating on the water surface or in the water, said control system comprising: a measurement unit that acquires measured data using a measurement sensor mounted on each of the plurality of unmanned vessels; an object detection determination unit that processes the measured data to detect the object; an object analysis determination unit that determines at least one of the type, operation status, and dynamic performance of the detected object; and an unmanned vessel operation management unit that issues an operation command to the plurality of unmanned vessels. The unmanned vessel operation management unit determines the command content of the operation command for the plurality of unmanned vessels in accordance with the determination result from the object analysis determination unit.

title_en: Deep-sea mobile operation device with replaceable toolkit and replacement method of deep-sea mobile operation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep sea mobile operation device capable of replacing toolkits and a replacement method thereof, the device comprises a toolkit module, a mobile control module and a locking mechanism, the toolkit module comprises at least two independent toolkits; the toolkit is provided with a sampling device, and the toolkit performs underwater sampling through the sampling device; the mobile control module is detachably connected with the toolkit through the locking mechanism; the movement control module comprises a driving device, and the movement control module provides driving force through the driving device and can drive the tool bag to accurately move underwater. The method is carried out by the device. Through locking combination of the mobile control module and different toolkits, the toolkits can be replaced, the resource cost of operation is saved, and the operation efficiency is improved. Furthermore, the movement control module is provided with a driving device, accurate movement positioning can be carried out, autonomous operation is achieved, and the underwater operation efficiency and the operation quality are improved.

title_en: RISERLESS MODULAR SUBSEA WELL INTERVENTION, METHOD AND APPARATUS
abstract_en: A blowout preventer for a subsea well includes an electrical communication link 112 between a surface controller and a subsea controller; and a hydraulic link 116 between the subsea controller 108 and a subsea source of hydraulic fluid. The electrical link is created by a remotely operated vehicle 100A, possibly via its tether management system 102A. The fluid source may be housed on a skid 118, and positioned on the seabed. The system can include an accumulator and a pump.

title_en: Methods for coupling and positioning elements on a configurable vehicle
abstract_en: A field configurable autonomous vehicle includes modular elements and attachable components. The vehicle can be assembled from these modular elements and components to meet desired mission and performance characteristics without the need to purchase specially designed vehicles for each mission. The vehicle can include a mechanisms that magnetically attach and release configurable elements from the vehicle.

title_en: Underwater component detection equipment for roads and bridges in civil engineering and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses underwater component detection equipment for roads and bridges in civil engineering and a using method thereof. A diving ship body is included. A driving mechanism I is arranged on a right side of the diving ship body; and a swing mechanism is arranged on the left side of the bottom of the diving ship body, a limiting mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the swing mechanism, an extension mechanism is arranged in the limiting mechanism, a driving mechanism II is arranged on one side of the bottom of the diving ship body, and an adjusting mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the limiting mechanism. In the invention, when the bridge is detected, the detection equipment is installed through using the equipment, manual handheld detection equipment is replaced, manuallaunching is avoided, a user is prevented from being hurt underwater, and detection safety is improved; and then, a detection angle can be flexibly adjusted when the detection equipment is underwater, the detection angle can also be adjusted through the driving mechanism I, and therefore comprehensiveness and accuracy of detection data are guaranteed.

title_en: Marine observation system using drone
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a marine observation system using an unmanned aerial vehicle (drone), wherein a marine observation unit dropped by the drone onto a designated marine location floats stably on the water surface of a specific area and collects state changes in marine topography in real-time, then provide the state changes to the drone and a control server. More specifically, the marine observation system comprises: an unmanned aerial vehicle which autonomously flies along a predetermined route, and transmits and receives sea observation information and position information detected by GPS; a marine observation unit which is dropped into a designated area of interest by the aerial vehicle and transmits underwater observation information to the aerial vehicle; and a control server which determines a flight path for the aerial vehicle and an area of interest for dropping the marine observation unit, receives the sea observation information, the underwater observation information, and the position information from the aerial vehicle to generate and store a database, and includes: a wireless communication module receiving and identifying the underwater observation information transmitted from the aerial vehicle; an information detection module confirming a seabed location, water depth, and position data at an observation point included in the underwater observation information to generate two-dimensional or three-dimensional topographic images of the marine topography; and a storage module storing the topographic images over time. When the unmanned aerial vehicle moves to the area of interest, the unmanned aerial vehicle drops the marine observation unit, acquires the underwater information and the position information at the area of interest observed by the marine observation unit, and the marine information and the position information observed by the unmanned aerial vehicle, and transmits the acquired information to the control server. Therefore, the system can enhance the efficiency of marine observation, investigation, and monitoring.

title_en: Underwater environment detection system for unmanned amphibious vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater environment detection system for an unmanned amphibious vehicle, and aims to provide a wide underwater field of view to a driver, improve water travelling efficiency of the unmanned amphibious vehicle and improve the overall operational performance of the unmanned amphibious vehicle. The system comprises a video capture module, a video transmission module, a video display module and a control switch module which are distributed on a vehicle body of the unmanned amphibious vehicle and a remote control terminal, wherein in the video capture module, two underwater cameras and a forward-looking sonar are mounted in the middle of the front part of the bottom of the vehicle, a detection zone of the cameras and the sonar is in the direction below the front part of the vehicle, and the front edge of the detection zone is parallel to the bottom plane of the vehicle; two side scanning sonars are mounted in the center of the bottom of the vehicle, detection angles of the two side scanning sonars are in the direction below the front part of the vehicle, and a rear edge of a detection zone of the two side scanning sonars is parallel to the bottom plane of the vehicle; video signals captured by a detector are transmitted to a display of the remote control terminal in a wireless transmission manner to be displayed; and the control switch module is used for transmitting an operation of the remote control terminal to the vehicle to control the detector to work or shut down.

title_en: Intelligent underwater observation platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent underwater observation platform, including a sensor, a floating body device, a platform floating ball, a screw propeller and a hoist, wherein the hoist is arranged in the hoist case; the platform floating ball is fixed on the top of the case top plate of the hoist case; a cable on the hoist passes through the case top plate; a middle passage of the platform floating ball is connected with the floating body device, and the screw propeller is installed on the top of the case top plate through a propeller bracket; the sensor comprises a sensor housing and ahydrological detection sensor and a power supply battery arranged inside the sensor housing; the platform floating ball is a shell structure with a channel arranged in the middle and a confined spaceinside; and the shell is provided with a communication module, a control module and an energy module inside the shell. The intelligent underwater observation platform provided by the invention does not need to be anchored on the seabed, and the whole platform can be automatically lifted and lowered in the seawater, and the water body of different depths is automatically detected, and the floatingbody device arranged under the water surface does not affect the navigation channel.

title_en: Multifunctional underwater flaw detection underwater vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ocean underwater detection, in particular to a multifunctional underwater flaw detection underwater vehicle which comprises an underwater vehicle body, a bottom platform, a pressing device, a lifting forward moving frame, a top platform and a detection assembly, and after the lifting forward moving frame stretches, the top platform can move upwards and forwards relative to the bottom platform; the detection assembly can be located at the position, beneficial to nondestructive testing, of the front portion of the underwater vehicle body; the detection assembly can be overturned on the top platform through the overturning driving mechanism, conversion from the horizontal state to the vertical state is achieved, and through the combined action of the overturning driving mechanism and the lifting forward moving frame, the position of the detection assembly in the vertical state can be located above the front portion of the underwater vehicle body.

title_en: Multi-role unmanned vehicle system and associated methods
abstract_en: An unmanned vehicle may include a vehicle body that comprises an enclosed hull. The unmanned vehicle may include a propulsion, a ballast control system, a center of gravity system, a pressurization system, a control surface system, a navigation control system, and an on board master control system. The on board master control system may execute local control over operation of the various systems of the unmanned vehicle. The unmanned vehicle may also include a power supply carried by a portion of the vehicle body to provide power to the various systems. The various systems of the unmanned vehicle may be independently operable to support selective operation of the unmanned vehicle in the air, on the surface of the water, and below the surface of the water.

title_en: Deep-sea cross-domain unmanned aerial vehicle and method thereof for completing autonomous deep-sea exploration task
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for completing an autonomous deep-sea exploration task by a deep-sea cross-domain unmanned aerial vehicle. The method comprises the following steps: determining a target area; taking off to a specified height from the sea level, receiving a task execution command and then flying to a target area; when the relative distance between the current position and the coordinates of the target area reaches a preset value, descending; when it is detected that the device is contacted with seawater, the device dives through gravity; when it is detected that the set depth is reached, the propeller is restarted, and the detection task is executed; after the detection task is completed, the standby battery is rejected and ascends; after leaving the water surface, rising to a specified height and switching to a homeward flight mode; and when the deep-sea cross-domain unmanned aerial vehicle is within the sight distance range, a manual landing task is executed. The invention further discloses the deep-sea cross-domain unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the unmanned aerial vehicle and the method, autonomous switching operation between an air medium and an underwater medium can be realized, and the unmanned aerial vehicle has the capability of autonomously completing detection and water body sampling in an extreme deep sea environment.

title_en: Systems and methods for controlling operations of marine vessels
abstract_en: Systems, assemblies, and methods for conveniently operating marine devices associated with a watercraft are provided herein. An example system includes a controller, a sensor module, and a marine device. The controller is configured to receive a user input indicating a desired action via the sensor module and transmit a signal to the marine device to cause the marine device to operate in a particular manner. The sensor module may include one or more motion sensors, and the controller may be configured to filter unintentional movement from the raw motion data sensed by the sensor module, such as due to movement of the watercraft floating on the surface of the water. Thus, the system may enable convenient and intuitive control over various marine devices associated with the watercraft.

title_en: ASV FOR UNDERWATER CULTURAL ASSET EXPLORATION
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an autonomous surface vehicle for underwater cultural heritage investigation, and more specifically, to an autonomous surface vehicle for underwater cultural heritage investigation, which can easily investigate cultural heritage buried underwater through underwater complex exploration. The autonomous surface vehicle (ASV), which includes two hulls and a central body provided between the hulls, comprises: an investigation module equipped on the autonomous surface vehicle for underwater complex exploration; a control module provided in the central body for autonomous movement control of the autonomous surface vehicle, data collection from the data investigated by the investigation module, and determination of cultural heritage based on the collected data; and a connection unit connecting the central body to each hull, and including a spacing adjustment part capable of adjusting a distance between each hull from the central body and a fixing part fixing the adjusted hulls.

title_en: POSITION CONTROL SYSTEM AND POSITION CONTROL METHOD OF ON-WATER ROBOT
abstract_en: An unmanned surface vehicle for underwater investigation that is free from negative effect of a thruster is provided. A position control system for an unmanned surface vehicle includes: at least one mooring device fixed on the ground; a wire fed and wound from the mooring device; an unmanned surface vehicle connected at the tip end of the wire; and at least one rudder equipped on the unmanned surface vehicle, wherein the mooring device includes a mooring device control device for controlling the feeding and winding of the wire, and a rudder control device for drive-controlling the rudder, the mooring device control device and the rudder control device control the position of the unmanned surface vehicle to reach the target.

title_en: Portable underwater vehicle floating state adjusting device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater vehicle initial floating state adjustment, and discloses a portable underwater vehicle floating state adjusting device which comprises a shell, a sliding assembly and a balance weight. The shell is a hollow semi-cylinder, and the shell is attached to the inner wall of the underwater vehicle; the sliding assembly is arranged on the shell in the axial direction of the shell, and the balance weight is arranged on the sliding assembly. The sliding assembly can drive the balance weight to move in the axial direction of the shell. According to the invention, the initial floating state of the underwater vehicle is conveniently and efficiently adjusted, and the manpower and time cost of the test are saved.

title_en: Self-propelled underwater detection lander device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-propelled underwater detection lander device which comprises a frame structure, a sealed cabin is arranged on the frame structure, a control box is arranged in the sealed cabin, the control box is in wireless communication connection with a remote controller, a propeller electrically connected with the control box is arranged on one side of the frame structure, and a variable buoyancy structure is arranged on the sealed cabin. The variable buoyancy structure is in control connection with the control box, and a load rejection structure is arranged at the bottom of the sealed cabin. The unmanned aerial vehicle can complete laying and recovery without a mother ship, can realize underwater autonomous navigation, can submerge to the water bottom through a variable buoyancy structure after navigating to a specified position on the water surface during laying, and floats up by virtue of the buoyancy of the unmanned aerial vehicle during recovery, and has great economic popularization value.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle and unmanned ship collaborative exploration method and system in unknown water area environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooperative exploration method and system for an unmanned aerial vehicle and an unmanned ship in an unknown water area environment. The unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned ship keep communication connection. The exploration method comprises the following steps: S1, exploration of a water environment: the unmanned aerial vehicle autonomously explores a water area to be explored, completes exploration of the water environment, constructs a map, and transmits the map to the unmanned ship; s2, underwater environment exploration: the unmanned ship performs path planning according to the map and detects the underwater environment in the moving process to complete exploration of underwater environment information; and S3, overwater and underwater information fusion: according to the GNSS coordinate information of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned ship, completing map fusion at the same coordinate position, and obtaining overall data of the overwater and underwater environment of the unknown water area. According to the method, the unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned ship are used for exploring water and water respectively, and the water exploration information provides a path planning basis for the unmanned ship, so that the problems of collision of the unmanned ship and the like are avoided, and the condition of an unknown water area can be explored quickly and comprehensively.

title_en: UNMANNED SEA EXPLORATION SYSTEM, MANAGEMENT DEVICE, AND CONTROL METHOD OF UNMANNED SEA EXPLORATION SYSTEM
abstract_en: To provide an inexpensive unmanned sea exploration system which enables a series of sea exploration work to be unmanned.SOLUTION: In an unmanned sea exploration system, a ship which can receive a steering signal, transmitted from an RC controller 23 through a predetermined network, through a transmitting and receiving antenna to navigate, a water drone 31 which conducts undersea exploration based on an exploration signal transmitted from the RC controller 23, and a management device 11 which processes exploration information transmitted from the ship 1 can communicate with each other. The unmanned sea exploration system receives the exploration information transmitted from the ship 1 to analyze geographical information of a sea bottom and shape information of a structure part installed on the sea bottom, creates a 3D sea bottom exploration image indicating sea bottom ground forms and sea bottom structures indicating an exploration result based on the analyzed exploration information, and links the created 3D sea bottom exploration image to a predetermined marine chart to accumulate the linked data.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Towed underwater vehicle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ocean observation and relates to assistive technology of ocean observation, in particular to a towed underwater vehicle, mainly aiming at measurement of high-density section observation parameters in regional waters. The towed underwater vehicle comprises a carrying device, an adjusting mechanism and an internal control unit, wherein the carrying device is used for carrying underwater exploration instruments, the adjusting mechanism and the internal control unit, the adjusting mechanism is used for adjusting running depth of the towed underwater vehicle, and the internal control unit is used for controlling the adjusting mechanism to enable the same to be capable of completing high-density section measurement. The towed underwater vehicle has the advantages that high-density section measurement can be completed without stopping of the towed underwater vehicle, so that time is saved; the towed underwater vehicle is capable of carrying multiple kinds of instruments, convenient to use and saving in cost; the towed underwater vehicle is high in maneuverability intrinsically and capable of achieving operation under multiple conditions, thereby being high in practical value; the towed underwater vehicle is quite small in size, thereby being carried conveniently during ocean expedition.

title_en: ROBOT DEVICE, ROBOT CONTROL METHOD, AND PROGRAM
abstract_en: To provide a robot device capable of easily tracking a linear structure installed underwater.SOLUTION: The robot device 20 includes an MBS 23, an image processing unit 42, a position detection unit 43, and a thruster control unit 44. The MBS 23 generates an underwater acoustic image. The image processing unit 42 extracts an image of the mooring line contained in the acoustic image. The position detection unit 43 detects a relative position of the mooring line with respect to the robot body 21 based on the acoustic image and the image of the mooring line. The thruster control unit 44 controls thrusters 22a and 22b based on the detected position of the mooring line obtained by the position detection unit 43.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Coupling and support mechanism for bending stiffeners with single external drive
abstract_en: The present invention relates to coupling/uncoupling and support mechanisms for connecting bend stiffeners to bellmouths, and aims to optimize pull-in and pull-out operations, reduce operating costs and times, and also completely replace shallow dives by operations without associated man-hours exposed to risk, such as those carried out using remotely-operated vehicles (ROVs). The proposed solution envisages a mechanism for coupling/uncoupling and supporting a bend stiffener, comprising a frontal actuation means, which has the feature of being easy to access and operate using ROVs, thereby replacing the multiple latch mechanisms used previously.

title_en: DEEP WATER INTERVENTION SYSTEM
abstract_en: 1. An intervention system for servicing subsea wells or pipelines from a subsea location comprising: (a) a tool delivery device; (b) a reel to hold the tool delivery device; (c) an injector head, (d) a carousel tool caddy; (e) a blow-out-preventer assembly; (f) a power pack; (g) a control pod; (h) a test pump; and i) an open space frame. 2. The system of claim 1 wherein the tool delivery device is selected from the group consisting of wire line, stiff wire, coiled tubing, and reeled pipe. 3. The system of claim 2 wherein the intervention system includes as an additional component a control umbilical cord. 4. The system of claim 3 wherein the tool delivery device is wire line. 5. The system of claim 3 wherein the tool delivery device is stiff wire. 6. The system of claim 3 wherein the tool delivery device is coiled tubing. 7. The system of claim 2 wherein the tool caddy comprises an index plate and three or more tool canisters holding three or more tools. 8. The system of claim 7 wherein tile intervention system comprises at least two tool caddies. 9. The system of claim 8 wherein the tools in the tool caddy are held in place with tool catchers. 10. The system of claim 8 wherein one or more tool canisters are enclosed to prevent the intrusion, of seawater and contain wellbore pressure. 11. The system of claim 3 wherein the intervention system allows replacement of a tool in a tool caddy by a remotely operated vehicle. 12. The system of claim 3 wherein the space frame can be disconnected into two sections, a first section comprising a carousel tool caddy, and a second section comprising a blow-out-preventer assembly, wherein the first section may be removed from the second section, to allow replacement of tools in the tool caddy. 13. The system of claim 3 wherein the reel holding the tool delivery device is pressurized. 14. The system of claim 3 wherein the tool delivery device is pressurized. 15.
