title_en: Underwater PNT system with wide-area coverage and autonomous monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater PNT system with wide-area coverage and autonomous monitoring. The underwater PNT system comprises a water surface section, a user section, an underwater section and a shore-based control center, the water surface section is provided with a space-time reference transmission device and a communication node, and is used for transmitting space-time reference of aBeidou satellite navigation system to the underwater section for information interaction; the user section is provided with a user terminal; the underwater section is provided with an underwater PNT network, and a user terminal carries out underwater positioning, navigation and time service by using the underwater PNT network; the underwater PNT network is configured to be a regional network composed of seabed base station links constructed by a plurality of seabed base stations, and the underwater PNT network is enabled to have autonomous monitoring through the seabed base station links; andthe shore-based control center is used for monitoring the working states of the water surface section, the user section and the underwater section and processing the acquired data. The underwater PNTsystem has an integrity monitoring function, has an inter-base-station link function and a wide-area service capability, has a conduction integration function and a remote communication function, andcan perform adaptive correction according to sea area environment characteristics.

title_en: Movable underwater observation system based on Internet of Things control and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a movable underwater observation system based on Internet of Things control and a working method thereof, and the system comprises an intelligent transmission winch A, underwater observation equipment, a marine special cable, an intelligent winch, an intelligent transmission winch B, a transmission rope, and a fixed pulley. According to the system, horizontal movement of the underwater observation equipment is achieved, longitudinal movement of the underwater observation equipment is achieved by combining control of the intelligent winch, depth data of the underwater observation equipment can be read through a background, and underwater fixed-point observation, horizontal and three-dimensional section observation and cruise observation of the underwater observation equipment are controlled through remote setting. According to the technical scheme, modularized equipment is easy to install and use; the automation degree is high, and remote control is achieved based on the Internet of Things; unmanned operation can be realized; according to a system feedback mechanism, the whole system can be combined with observation equipment data for program optimization; and storing the historical observation record file.

title_en: Double submerged body small water plane composite water surface unmanned surface vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double submerged body small water plane composite water surface unmanned surface vehicle. The double submerged body small water plane composite water surface unmanned surface vehicle comprises two underwater submerged bodies arranged in parallel, a supporting body arranged above the two underwater submerged bodies, a surface floating body supported at the top of the supporting body and boosting devices respectively arranged on stern portions of the two underwater submerged bodies. A sensing platform capable of being lifted and descended is embedded at the top of the surface floating body, the supporting body is in a reversed Y-shaped structure, two layers of hydrofoils are symmetrically arranged on two sides of a vertical side of the supporting body from top to bottom, an upper layer hydrofoil is arranged under the surface floating body, the lower layer hydrofoil is arranged under the upper layer hydrofoil, the two layers of hydrofoils are in V-shaped structures, the bottom layer hydrofoil is horizontally fixed between two lateral sides of the supporting body. The comprehensive performance of the double submerged body small water plane composite water surface unmanned surface vehicle is superior to common planing boats and regular three-body boat type water surface unmanned surface vehicles, particularly, operation, swaying movements and controllability are greatly improved. Compared with the common planing boats and the regular three-body boat type water surface unmanned surface vehicles, the seaworthiness is over 60% higher, and accordingly normal operation of the mini-type unmanned surface vehicle under high sea state conditions is enabled to be possible.

title_en: Multi-joint submersible for deep sea detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-joint submersible for deep sea detection. The multi-joint submersible comprises a flow guiding cabin, a control cabin, a propelling cabin, a propeller and tail rudders, wherein the flow guiding cabin is connected with the control cabin through a two-degree-of-freedom joint; the control cabin and the propelling cabin are connected through another two-degree-of-freedom joint; the propeller is fixedly connected to the rear part of the propelling cabin; the tail rudders are uniformly distributed on the rear part of the propelling cabin around the axis; the controlcabin is a dry cabin part of the submersible, a pressure-resistant design is adopted, and two slideways are symmetrically distributed on the two sides inside the control cabin; the control cabin comprise a control cabin shell, batteries, a power supply, an iridium satellite communication module, a GPS communication module, a central controller and two gyroscopes, and a motor and a driver which arefor driving the two two-degree-of-freedom joints are arranged in the control cabin; the batteries are fixed to the slideways in the control cabin shell; and angle information of the two two-degree-of-freedom joints detected by the two gyroscopes is transmitted to the central controller, and the iridium satellite communication module and the GPS communication module are connected with the centralcontroller.

title_en: Device and System for Underwater platform Multi-mode Management of Floating Platform
abstract_en: According to the present invention, disclosed are a device and a method for operating a composite mode of an underwater platform and a floating platform which provide a mode control part selecting a propulsion mode to control an underwater platform in accordance with changes detected in an environment detection part, thereby stably complexly operating the underwater platform and the floating platform in accordance with the changes of the external environment.

title_en: Method and apparatus for transporting ballast and cargo in an autonomous vehicle
abstract_en: A field configurable autonomous vehicle includes modular elements and attachable components. The vehicle can be assembled from these modular elements and components to meet desired mission and performance characteristics without the need to purchase specially designed vehicles for each mission. The vehicle can include a mechanisms that magnetically attach and release payloads such as cargo or ballast from the vehicle.

title_en: Deep-sea landform joint matching aided navigation and positioning system and deep-sea landform joint matching aided navigation and positioning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a deep-sea landform joint matching aided navigation and positioning system and a deep-sea landform joint matching aided navigation and positioning method. The system comprises an underwater topography and landform basic database unit, an inertial navigation unit, a sounding side-scan sonar, an underwater topography and landform joint matching unit and a combined navigation information fusion unit which are arranged in a deep sea vehicle; the underwater topography and landform joint matching unit is connected with the underwater topography and landform basic database unit, the inertial navigation unit, the sounding side-scan sonar and the combined navigation information fusion unit, and the combined navigation information fusion unit is connected with the inertial navigation unit. According to the invention, the accuracy of underwater navigation and positioning can be improved, and deep-sea accurate matching navigation and positioning can be realized.

title_en: Underwater flow field sensing and detecting equipment for amphibious vehicle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of underwater flow field detection, and particularly relates to underwater flow field sensing detection equipment for an amphibious vehicle, an attached seat of a telescopic data acquisition device of the underwater flow field sensing detection equipment is connected with the bottom of the amphibious vehicle through a bolt, a retainer is connected with the upper end face of the attached seat through a bolt, and a telescopic rod penetrates out of through holes of the attached seat and the retainer; meanwhile, the data acquisition box is in threaded connection with the telescopic rod, the pressure sensor is installed in a surface through hole of the data acquisition box, and the data acquisition device can move up and down through the telescopic rod; according to the displacement control device, a stepping motor is connected with a retainer through a bolt, a lead screw base is connected with the retainer through a bolt, the stepping motor is connected with a lead screw through a coupler, and under the action of rotation of the motor, a sliding block is connected with a telescopic rod through a bolt, so that stretching and retracting of the data acquisition device are achieved. The sensor acquires data and transmits the data to the multi-path data acquisition card, the data is converted into a bus signal through a protocol, the bus signal is output to the vehicle-mounted terminal, and finally the data is displayed on the display.

title_en: Control system and method for cooperative surveying and mapping of unmanned ship and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control system and a control method for the cooperative surveying and mapping of an unmanned ship and an unmanned aerial vehicle. The control system comprises an unmanned ship cooperative surveying and mapping device in the unmanned ship and an unmanned aerial vehicle cooperative surveying and mapping device in the unmanned aerial vehicle which performs mutual communication cooperative surveying and mapping. The automatic surveying and mapping of shoal sea areas with many islands and reefs are realized; the surveying and mapping task of a sea area which cannot be reached by a large surveying and mapping ship can be completed with high efficiency and low cost, meanwhile, the submarine topography can be surveyed and mapped, the surveying and mapping of an upper portion of an island reef can be achieved, and the surveying and mapping task of a target sea area is achieved more completely. The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned ship and unmanned aerial vehicle cooperative application.

title_en: Hydrogen from deep ocean nuclear Power
abstract_en: A pressure vessel 6 (e.g. for electrolytic hydrogen production from water) is submerged in fluid (e.g. deep under water in the ocean) to reduce the pressure differential. The hydrogen and oxygen production may be powered by a nuclear reactor 7. The submerged production platform 5 including the container 6 and reactor 7 may be tethered to a docking platform 1 using cables 4, with pipes allowing the hydrogen and oxygen gases to be sent from the vessel 6 to the dock 1. Both platforms may float underwater at different depths which may be controlled using buoyancy spaces â_x0080__x0093_ the production platform deeper that the shallower dock. The dock may include a manifold 2 allowing connection of unmanned autonomous sea-going submersible transport vessels (submarine vehicles) 3 for transporting the hydrogen to remote sea ports, and for electrically powering and controlling the dock. The dock may also be connected to surface buoys 8.

title_en: Underwater vehicle
abstract_en: Various aspects can be implemented to provide a reconfigurable underwater vehicle. In general, one aspect of the subject matter described in this specification can be embodied in a underwater vehicle that includes a hull that is angular in shape and capable of avoiding sonar detection. The hull can include a bow and a stern that are substantially similar in shape. The underwater vehicle can also include a plurality of reconfigurable modules that are interconnected to form the hull of the underwater vehicle. Each reconfigurable module is capable of performing a different function associated with operation of the underwater vehicle. Further, the plurality of reconfigurable modules can be built in a warehouse away from a shipyard and assembled to form the underwater vehicle at the shipyard.

title_en: Amphibious observer for observing underwater environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an amphibious observer for observing an underwater environment, and belongs to the field of ocean observation equipment. The amphibious observer comprises a machine body, carbon fiber vehicle arms, an unmanned aerial vehicle module, a control module, a power module, an observation module, a communication module and a buoyancy assembly, and watertight treatment is conductedon the whole amphibious observer; the four unmanned aerial vehicle modules are evenly distributed at the positions, close to the outer edge, of the upper surface of the machine body in the circumferential direction through carbon fiber vehicle arms. The buoyancy assembly is used for providing buoyancy; the power module, the communication module and the control module are sequentially installed onthe central axis of the stress plate. And the observation module is mounted on the outer peripheral surface of the front end of the machine body. The amphibious observer is simple in overall structure, light and convenient to carry and arrange. The watertight cabin provided with the power supply module, the communication module and the control module adopts a carbon fiber plate structure, so thatthe requirements of light weight and high strength are met; the buoyancy part is light in material, easy to carry, simple in overall structure, light in weight and capable of meeting the flight requirement of unmanned aerial vehicle loads.

title_en: Lake dynamic storage capacity monitoring method based on unmanned ship and apparatus thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lake monitoring, and concretely relates to a lake dynamic storage capacity monitoring method based on an unmanned ship. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a cruise instruction, programming several target points, forming a spiral cruise path; carrying out the spiral path cruise, recording a plane coordinate and water level elevation of each target position; drafting a underwater three dimensional map according to the recorded plane coordinate and the water level elevation, and calculating storage capacity through a contour volumemethod; and performing multitime cruise and calculating the dynamic storage capacity. According to the lake dynamic storage capacity monitoring method based on the unmanned ship, the three-dimensionaltopographic map is drafted by programming the spiral path cruise detection, automatic monitoring and analysis of the dynamic storage capacity is carried out, and the lake dynamic storage capacity monitoring method has the advantages of high efficiency, high precision and high reliability.

title_en: Underwater remotely controlled unmanned navigation vehicle allows each aquatic vehicle to perform filming, monitoring, and detection in different water areas separately without the need to personally control or launch at the front line, making the operation safer and more convenient
abstract_en: An underwater remotely controlled unmanned navigation vehicle, used for monitoring devices on or under water surface, comprises: a hull including a front compartment, a payload compartment, and a rear compartment, wherein a hatch is located on the upper side of the payload compartment of the hull; a launch rack positioned inside the payload compartment; at least one launch tube installed inside the launch rack, wherein each launch tube is equipped with at least one aquatic vehicle, which conducts monitoring on or under the water surface and transmits monitoring signals to a remote device, and the aquatic vehicle is remotely controlled by receiving remote signals to determine its position; the launch rack is used to drive the launch tube, causing the launch tube to be launched sequentially from the hatch. It also includes a vehicle main engine, a vehicle displacement steering device, a vehicle fuel supply system, a vehicle power supply system providing the necessary power for the system, a vehicle power system connected to the vehicle power supply system for driving the vehicle to the required position, and a vehicle remote control electronic system connected to the vehicle power supply system and receiving GPS signals transmitted from the front-end vehicle main engine. This allows remote users to control the vehicle wirelessly. The vehicle can be navigated to the required position by operators or automatic remote control, the hatch of the payload compartment can be opened, and then the aquatic vehicles inside the vehicle can be launched sequentially. After leaving the vehicle, the aquatic vehicles can also be navigated to the set destinations by operators or automatic remote control, allowing each aquatic vehicle to perform filming, monitoring, and detection in different water areas separately. Operators do not need to personally control or launch at the front line, making the operation safer and more convenient.

title_en: SUBSEA ENERGY STORAGE FOR BLOW OUT PREVENTER (BOP)
abstract_en: A subsea energy storage for well control equipment, wherein stored energy near a well on the sea floor monitors and activates well control equipment independently of, or in conjunction with, hydraulic energy. Energy to the subsea energy storage can be supplied by surface umbilical, remotely- operated vehicle, or by subsea electrical generation from stored hydraulic energy. Stored electrical energy may also recharge stored hydraulic energy. A subsea control system is configured to record data, compare the data to predetermined event signatures, and operate the well control equipment with stored electrical energy.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle suitable for complex environment and autonomous obstacle avoidance method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unmanned vehicle suitable for a complex environment and an automatic obstacle avoidance method, and belongs to the field of long-distance tunnel unmanned vehicle equipment development. The underwater ultrasonic sensor scans, detects and obtains position, depth and height information of underwater protruding obstacles, pits and the like, the liquid level sensor senses the elevation relation between the bottom of the unmanned vehicle and the water surface, and the industrial personal computer plans the advancing path of the unmanned vehicle according to an obstacle avoidance algorithm. Therefore, the unmanned vehicle can adapt to complex terrain environments of tunnel bottom plate pit punching, steel bar exposure and clogging of debris such as block stones and branches, safely walks and works in a long tunnel complex environment, and autonomous obstacle avoidance is achieved.

title_en: Gimbal stabilized components for remotely operated aerial vehicles
abstract_en: The present invention extends to methods, systems, devices, and apparatus for augmented radar camera view for remotely operated vehicles. A camera and a radar unit are co-located on a remotely controlled aerial vehicle, for example, in a forward looking view. The camera captures images and the radar unit senses reflections from transmitted waves. The images (operator view) and radar returns (radar view) are combined in an augmented view. The augmented view is displayed to an operator (e.g., a pilot) at a control station to provide the operator with an augmented reality sense of obstacles in the environment of the remotely controlled aerial vehicle. Thus, when a remotely controlled aerial vehicle is flying through an environment that may be dark, clouded, foggy, etc., the operator may still be able to detect obstacles from the radar view.

title_en: Automated Benthic Ecology System and Method for Photomosaic and 3-D Model Generation
abstract_en: An automated benthic ecology system comprising a remotely operated vehicle upon which an environmental sensor package and photomosaicing technology are mounted, the remotely operated vehicle configured to operate in benthic habitats, the photomosaicing technology comprising a high-resolution still camera, a high-resolution video camera, and a stereoscopic camera, the environmental sensor package comprising a plurality of sensors.

title_en: REMOTE CONTROL SYSTEM OF UNMANNED OBSERVATION VEHICLE
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A remote control system of unmanned observation vehicle is provided to obtain ocean information of a desired place and to avoid the place of a bad weather condition by installing the unmanned observation vehicle. CONSTITUTION: An INS(Inertial Navigation System)(110) determines navigation location using a location and velocity information of unmanned observation vehicle. An automatic sailing system(120) controls automatic sailing using engine speed, RPM(Rotation Per Minute), fuel amount and source power. A sensor unit(130) collects all kinds of ocean information. A controller(140) controls the INS, automatic navigation system and sensor unit.

title_en: Wearable small frogman carrier with vector propulsion function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of underwater frogman vector propulsion, in particular to a wearable small frogman carrier with a vector propulsion function and a control method, and the carrier comprises a bag body assembly, a propulsion assembly and a control system; the propelling assembly comprises four propellers; the control system comprises a function board, a main control board, four electronic speed regulators, a depth sensor, an inertial navigation module, a satellite positioning navigation module, an instruction controller, a battery pack and a waterproof navigation screen. Aiming at the defects of inconvenience in carrying, inconvenience in operation, backward control method, poor attitude stability, single function and the like of a traditional vehicle, a vector propulsion technology and a wearable technology are combined, and a wearable small frogman vehicle with vector propulsion is designed. When a frogman wears the carrier to prepare for operation, the carrier can be carried on the back, and instructions of advancing, retreating, steering, pitching posture changing, acceleration and deceleration are given to the propeller by rotating the adjusting knob.

title_en: UNDERWATER VEHICLE
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an underwater vehicle capable of reacting quickly to sudden geography variation.SOLUTION: The underwater vehicle comprises plural distance sensors and a height estimation part. The plural distance sensors estimate distance between the vehicle body and a water bottom about each of plural directions having different angles of depression respectively to a horizontal direction. The height estimation part estimates the height of the vehicle body from the water bottom on each position among plural front positions based on the measured distance and angles of depression to each of plural directions.

title_en: FLOATING PLATFORM FOR MARITIME SURVEILLANCE
abstract_en: An unmanned, autonomous, self-sustaining and self-repairable floating platform (10) which is positioned at a fixed location within the sea, capable of constantly monitoring, without having to be removed, a specific maritime zone including a sea surface area and the aerial and underwater space pertaining to this sea surface area, the platform comprising telecommunication means adapted to exchange surveillance related information with a Command, Communication and Control center (43). The platform comprises a deck (1) maintained well above sea surface through a connecting member (11) with an underlying, fully or partially submerged, system of floaters (2) and is equipped with a variety of sensors and surveillance systems such as radar, Lidar, sonar, electromagnetic, unmanned vehicles (UAVs, UUVs and US Vs), active and passive self-protection systems as well as research and rescue equipment. A mast (6) having a substantial height (usually 40-50m) and equipped with appropriate surveillance

title_en: Underwater operation and deep detection method of unmanned ship loaded with soft robot
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an underwater operation and deep detection method for an unmanned ship loaded with a soft robot. The method comprises the steps that firstly, the soft robot and execution methods for different operations are designed according to operation tasks of the unmanned ship; secondly, connection, including control, data transmission and the like, between the load soft robot and the unmanned ship and between the load soft robot and the main station is achieved; and finally, the load soft robot is put into the working environment of the unmanned ship to execute operation and detection, and operation information is output. In underwater operation and deep detection of an unmanned ship of a load soft robot, connection between the load soft robot and the unmanned ship as well as connection between the load soft robot and a main station are very important. Implementation of connection among a load soft robot, an unmanned ship and a master station relates to multiple technical fields including communication, energy supply, control, mechanical design and the like. Different task requirements and environment conditions are comprehensively considered, a proper technical scheme needs to be formulated, and collaborative operation and task completion of the whole system are ensured.

title_en: Pull type independent depth underwater observation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pull type independent depth underwater observation system which comprises a pull connection frame which is arranged at the top of a framework and is tightly connected with the framework, an AMR main control electronic cabin arranged inside the framework, perpendicular propellers connected with the AMR main control electronic cabin, sensors which are fixed on the framework and are connected with the AMR main control electronic cabin, a video observation module which is fixed at the front end of the framework and is connected with the AMR main control electronic cabin, LED lamps which are fixed on the framework and are located on the same side with the video observation module, and floating blocks which are arranged on two sides of the framework and are fitted with the framework. The pull type independent depth underwater observation system is large in observation range, high in stability and low in cost; by use of the bionic design idea, the pull type independent depth underwater observation system can be put to the most appropriate observation water depth to meet underwater shooting and observation requirements; the pull type independent depth underwater observation system has the advantages of simple design, pure digital storage and transmission, POE (Power Over Ethernet) power supplying, carrying depth-posture-speed sensor, full automation and the like, and can realize marine environment surveying, submarine topography mapping, marine rehabilitation works, underwater searching, and underwater searching and observation of military reconnaissance.

title_en: An intelligent floating drainage pipeline inspection system
abstract_en: This invention belongs to the field of urban drainage pipeline inspection technology and discloses an intelligent floating drainage pipeline inspection system. It includes a detection device body and floating wings located on the left and right sides of the detection device body. The detection device body comprises a shell and a power supply unit, autonomous navigation unit, control unit, and obstacle avoidance unit located inside the shell. The drive unit is installed at the rear of the shell, the camera unit is installed above the shell. The drive unit, power supply unit, camera unit, autonomous navigation unit, and obstacle avoidance unit are all electrically connected to the control unit. The cloud processing unit consists of sequentially connected data analysis modules and detection report generation modules. The data analysis module is connected to the control unit for communication. The user terminal is connected to the detection report generation module for communication.

title_en: Fixed and maneuvering coordinated ocean three-dimensional synchronous observation system and fixed and maneuvering coordinated ocean three-dimensional synchronous observation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fixed and maneuvering coordinated ocean three-dimensional synchronous observation system and method. The system comprises a fixed node; a maneuvering node; the fixed nodes and the maneuvering nodes cooperate to cover blank areas and observation and detection blind areas between the nodes; the ship-based unmanned aerial vehicle is used for carrying the fixed nodes and the maneuvering nodes and putting the fixed nodes and the maneuvering nodes to preset positions; and the water surface ship is configured to continuously emit underwater acoustic signals through a carried sound source during advancing, collect fixed node information and maneuvering node information, and regulate and control the navigation track of the maneuvering node and fixed node parameters in combination with an observation task so as to maintain the set coverage precision of the target ocean water body at any time. Compared with a traditional marine environment investigation method and a traditional marine observation network, the three-dimensional synchronous observation network formed by cooperation of the maneuvering nodes and the fixed nodes is more efficient and flexible, and more complete space-time matching environment data with a larger range and higher resolution can be obtained.

title_en: SMART STATION SYSTEM FOR UNMANNED MOVING OBJECTS FOR OCEAN OBSERVATION
abstract_en: Disclosed is a smart station system for ocean observation using unmanned moving objects. The smart station system for ocean observation by unmanned moving objects according to the present invention comprises: a structure of which a part is submerged and the rest is exposed on the surface of the water; a first docking part arranged in the underwater area of the structure so that unmanned moving objects autonomously driving on the seabed or underwater can be docked; a second docking part arranged in the water surface area of the structure so that the unmanned moving objects autonomously driving on the water surface can be docked; and a third docking part arranged in an upper portion of the structure so that the unmanned moving objects autonomously driving in the air can be docked. A data transmitting and receiving part and a power supply part electrically connected to the docked unmanned moving object to transmit and receive data are respectively arranged in the first docking part, the second docking part, and the third docking part.

title_en: Underwater residence system and unmanned aerial vehicle underwater residence and release method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater residence systems, and discloses an underwater residence system and an unmanned aerial vehicle underwater residence and release method. The underwater residence system comprises a releaser, an underwater hovering assembly and a fixed-point residence assembly, and the unmanned aerial vehicle is releasably connected to the underwater hovering assembly. The underwater hovering assembly is provided with a rope winding prevention piece, winding of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the underwater hovering assembly can be prevented, and underwater hovering of the unmanned aerial vehicle is achieved. The fixed-point parking assembly is used for providing a mooring point for the unmanned aerial vehicle. The equipment floating body of the underwater hovering assembly is provided with a Beidou user machine sea surface beacon end. The unmanned aerial vehicle underwater residing and releasing method uses the underwater residing system to enable the unmanned aerial vehicle to hover in a specific sea area, remote control releasing of the unmanned aerial vehicle is achieved by means of a Beidou satellite system, the unmanned aerial vehicle can be released at any time according to task requirements, and the task response time is greatly shortened.

title_en: Launching control method, system and equipment supporting multi-underwater-load launching and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of underwater control, and provides a launching control method, system and device supporting multi-underwater-load launching and a medium, and the control method comprises the steps: receiving a launching task instruction from a platform, and determining at least one target underwater load based on the launching task instruction; performing self-inspection on the target underwater load and an associated launching trigger mechanism, and judging whether to enter a launching preparation process or not based on a self-inspection result; if the launch preparation process is allowed to enter, target information from the platform is acquired, and launch motion elements are calculated and generated based on the target information; binding to a target underwater load according to the emission motion elements generated by resolving; according to the method, the unlocking instruction is sent to the launching triggering mechanism associated with the target underwater load, the pipe outlet detection signal of the target underwater load is received and analyzed, the pipe outlet state of the underwater load is judged, the feedback signal is generated, and therefore the flexibility and efficiency of underwater task execution are remarkably improved.

title_en: Deep sea detection device for unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of deep sea detection, and discloses a deep sea detection device for an unmanned aerial vehicle, which is characterized by comprising an aircraft body, a recovery auxiliary support plate and an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a central rotating shaft is arranged in the aircraft body, a plurality of clamping groups are arranged on the central rotating shaft, and a recovery station is formed in the aircraft body; the center rotating shaft drives the clamping sets to rotate so that the clamping sets can sequentially pass through a recycling station, overturning driving pieces are arranged between the clamping sets and the center rotating shaft, a plurality of supporting legs are arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle body, each supporting leg comprises a joint part so that the supporting leg can rotate and be bent, and one end of each supporting leg is rotationally connected with the unmanned aerial vehicle body. A suction cup part is formed at the other end of each supporting leg, a negative pressure driving part is arranged on each supporting leg, when the negative pressure driving parts work, negative pressure is formed on the suction cup parts, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle body gets close to the negative pressure side till the suction cups are attached to the recycling auxiliary supporting plate, and the positioning sets stretch out to move the unmanned aerial vehicle body to a preset recycling position; and the clamping part extends out to clamp the unmanned aerial vehicle body.

title_en: Subsea, releasable bop funnel
abstract_en: The invention is a device for eliminating the 'tripping' of the BOP stack to the surface when switching between drilling and completion modes of operation on a drilling rig. This device is a new apparatus for attaching a BOP guide funnel, which will allow the funnel to be released and/or reattached while the BOP remains subsea on or near the seafloor. The new BOP guide funnel assembly consists of three basic components: a guide funnel, a connector shroud and a parking pile adapter. The guide funnel has a downwardly opening funnel on bottom (used to capture a wellhead) and an upwardly opening smaller funnel on top (used to guide the shroud back into the guide funnel during re-installation of the guide funnel). The connector shroud is permanently attached to the bottom of the BOP stack, surrounding the BOP wellhead connector and holds the guide funnel in place. The connector shroud also acts as a guide for entering other subsea equipment designed in a funnel-up configuration when the guide funnel is not present. The connector shroud includes a latching mechanism for releasing and/or reattaching the guide funnel. The latching mechanism may be controlled either by the BOP control system or by intervention from a remotely operated vehicle (ROV). The parking pile adapter is designed to 'store' the funnel at the seafloor when it has been released from the BOP stack.

title_en: Semisubmersible unmanned platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to a semisubmersible unmanned platform. Most of the structure of the semisubmersible unmanned platform is under water, has strong wind and wave resistance, and also has the ability to work on water surface and under water at the same time. Compared with an unmanned surface vessel, the semisubmersible unmanned platform is smaller in the size of the part above the water surface, thus having higher crypticity and storm resistance. The semisubmersible unmanned platform ensures that the water surface operating platform of the semisubmersible platform is always above the watersurface through an active floating state adjusting mechanism, has the functions of water surface detection, communication and the like, and can complete the operating task required to be completed above the liquid level. The floating body structure adopts the shape of a double body structure, thus effectively alleviating the influence of the wave and the flow navigation state and increasing the stability. The semisubmersible platform has a simple structure, low manufacturing cost, wide operating range, and the capability of an underwater and water surface unmanned platform, can be widely applied to river and lake hydrological monitoring, port ship monitoring, etc., and is a promising device.

title_en: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR DETERMINING THE POSITION OF AN UNDERWATER VEHICLE
abstract_en: A system and a method are provided for determining the position of an underwater vehicle while the vehicle is operating underwater. A buoyant float stays on or near the surface of the water and is attached to the vehicle by thin tether that can include insulated wires. The vehicle moves under the water and pulls the float behind it. The float can receive a localization signal, such as a signal indicating its GPS position, and so can determine its position precisely. The position can be transmitted to the underwater vehicle over the wires located in the tether. The underwater vehicle can use sensors and/or calculations to determine the positional offset of the vehicle from the float buoy and generates its true position based on the known position of the float and the positional offset. The float can be constructed with attributes that will allow the float it operate with a greater tether length, and in turn allow the underwater vehicle to operate at greater depths. The float may also generally carry a radio system for high speed communication of signals from the vehicle while the vehicle is submerged.

title_en: DETERMINING A POSITION OF A SUBMERSIBLE VEHICLE WITHIN A BODY OF WATER
abstract_en: Methods and apparatus determining a position of a submersible vehicle within a body of water are provided. A method comprises determining an initial position of the vehicle while the vehicle is at or near a water surface. The method further comprises coupling the vehicle and a base node to a weight and determining a position of the base node once the base node and vehicle have reached the floor of the body of water using acoustic modems of the vehicle and a surface vessel to aid in calculating the position as they descend, and acoustically transferring the at rest position on the seafloor from the vehicle to the node. The method further comprises decoupling the vehicle from the node and weight and determining a position of the vehicle based on the position of the base node and acoustic signals exchanged between acoustic modems of the vehicle and the base node.

title_en: Underwater equipment deploying and retrieving system and navigation equipment
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of navigation equipment accessories. The invention provides an underwater equipment deploying and retrieving system and navigation equipment. The underwater equipment deploying and retrieving system comprises a fixed arm assembly and a supporting arm assembly, and the supporting arm assembly comprises at least one supporting main arm, a pulley andan equipment induction component. One end of the supporting main arm is connected with the fixed arm assembly; the other end is rotationally connected with the pulley; the equipment induction component comprises a sensor bracket and a sensor; the sensor is arranged on the sensor bracket, is arranged corresponding to the outer peripheral surface of the pulley and is spaced from the outer peripheral surface of the pulley; the sensor can detect whether the underwater equipment is close to the pulley or not, so that the underwater equipment can be prevented from colliding with the pulley to be damaged during deploying and retrieving, and normal work of the underwater equipment is guaranteed; according to the navigation equipment based on the underwater equipment deploying and retrieving system, the underwater equipment can be prevented from colliding with the pulleys to be damaged in the deploying and retrieving process, and normal work of the underwater equipment is guaranteed.

title_en: Method and system for synchronously collecting terrain under river and lake surface water
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for synchronously collecting terrain under river and lake surface water, the method is realized by adopting an unmanned aerial vehicle carrying a camera and a sonar ball, the sonar ball is connected with the unmanned aerial vehicle through a cable, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, formulating a collection task before taking off, comprising the steps of setting a flight height, a collection range, a starting point, camera aerial photography parameters and sonar parameters and planning a route, and the planned route comprises a coast surface water terrain synchronous collection route and a surface supplementary photography route; s2, the unmanned aerial vehicle flies to an initial point; s3, the sonar ball is placed on the water surface, the unmanned aerial vehicle sails according to the coast surface water terrain synchronous acquisition route, the camera performs coast surface terrain acquisition, and the sonar ball performs underwater terrain acquisition; and S4, the sonar ball is withdrawn to the unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle sails according to the earth surface supplementary shooting route, and the camera carries out earth surface terrain acquisition. According to the invention, rapid and synchronous acquisition of terrains under river and lake surface water can be realized.

title_en: Amphibious operation method of intelligent robot
abstract_en: The invention provides an amphibious operation method of an intelligent robot; in order to solve the positioning and communication problems existing in underwater operation of the intelligent robot in a shallow sea area, a GNSS/SINS (Global Navigation Satellite System/Strapdown Inertial Navigation System) integrated positioning method is combined with a robot operation movement process, operation is carried out through water surface and underwater amphibious circulation, traversal search is carried out in the underwater process by virtue of inertial positioning navigation. The water surface process receives external signals to carry out accurate positioning and communication, incremental correction is carried out on initialization parameters of the cyclic process through underwater motion data, and cyclic operation is carried out in the cycle, so that autonomy and flexibility of the intelligent robot can be kept, and the underwater traversal search operation requirement can be met.

title_en: SUBSEA STRUCTURE LOAD MONITORING AND CONTROL SYSTEM
abstract_en: A system for monitoring for loads in a subsea structure comprises one or more sensors disposed proximate a subsea structure such as a blow-out preventer. The sensors are configured to detect an induced load on a subsea structure. The detected load is communicated to a sensor data processor operatively in communication with the strain sensor. Using the detected load data, a load generator such as a remotely operated vehicle or other source of thrust has its thrust output adjusted to induce a load equal in force, but opposite in direction, to the detected induced loads.

title_en: Navigation system error correction method based on subsea pipeline node position assistance
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a navigation system error correction method based on subsea pipeline node position assistance. The method is designed based on a scheme of an integrated navigation system(strapdown inertial navigation system (INS) and Doppler velocimeter (DVL) for short) of a cableless submarine oil and gas pipe detection robot. Firstly, a submarine oil and gas pipeline detection robot enters water to perform inspection along a submarine pipeline, and a combined navigation system records the corrosion position of the submarine pipeline through INS and DVL combined calculation; and when a magnetic sensor installed on the submarine oil and gas pipe detection robot detects a submarine pipe node, a position error accumulated by the combined navigation system is corrected according to an accurate absolute position marked by the submarine pipe node, thereby realizing position correction under a dynamic condition. The detection robot is suitable for long-endurance and long-voyage oil and gas pipeline detection underwater, pipeline corrosion point position positioning can be accurately carried out, and guarantee is provided for seabed oil and gas pipeline detection and maintenance operation.

title_en: Multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle. The multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a motor and further comprises a vehicle body and a control system; the controlsystem is arranged in the vehicle body and electrically connected with the vehicle body; the vehicle body and the control system are electrically connected with the motor; the vehicle body comprises afuselage, wings, a tail wing and a propeller; each wing comprises a fixed part and a telescopic part, the fixed parts are rotatably connected with the side wall of the fuselage, and the propeller isfixedly connected to the tail of the fuselage; the control system comprises a processor, a camera device, a positioning system, a driving device, an obstacle avoidance system, a driving motor, a meteorological monitoring device and a sonar detector; the processor is electrically connected with the camera device, the driving device, the obstacle avoidance system, the driving motor, the meteorological monitoring device and the sonar detector; and the positioning system and the processor are connected with a ground control terminal. The multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle can be used in waterand air, the navigation speed is high, and the maritime reconnaissance task can be completed quickly and efficiently.

title_en: Efficient teleoperation of mobile robots via online adaptation
abstract_en: Described herein is a framework for efficient task-agnostic, user-independent adaptive teleoperation of mobile robots and remotely operated vehicles (ROV), including ground vehicles (including legged systems), aircraft, watercraft and spacecraft. The efficiency of a human operator is improved by minimizing the entropy of the control inputs, thereby minimizing operator energy and achieving higher performance in the form of smoother trajectories by concurrently estimating the user intent online and adaptively updating the action set available to the human operator.

title_en: Tracking monitoring platform for finite field underwater in-orbit navigation comprehensive test
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tracking monitoring platform for a finite field underwater on-orbit navigation comprehensive test, and the platform is characterized in that a gate-type tracking mechanism spans a dock wall of a finite field test water dock, operates through a gate-type moving trolley, and matches the operation state of a tracking vehicle; a motion monitoring system is configured, optical measurement, three-dimensional motion model capture and motion video image analysis are adopted, and high-precision collection of the running posture and motion parameter signals of the aircraft is achieved; the gate-type moving trolley is controlled by the motion monitoring system, and the running speed of the gate-type moving trolley is adjusted in real time according to feedback signals of the collection node array. According to the invention, the motion attitude and motion parameter change of the vehicle under different test working conditions can be recorded with high precision, and the motion speed of the gate-type moving trolley and the vehicle can be controlled to reach a tracking matching degree, so that the safe power supply of the power supply system to the vehicle is ensured; therefore, safe and effective proceeding of the underwater in-orbit navigation comprehensive test in the finite field is supported.

title_en: UNDERWATER NAVIGATION AND ON-WATER/UNDERWATER INTERACTIVE COMMUNICATION SYSTEM USING SMART PHONE
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To expand various functions of a smart phone under an underwater environment, to establish on-water/underwater interactive communication, to reduce the number of accessories carried by a diver, to design, develop and mount the sensor unit and the electronic control unit of an economical remotely-operated unmanned vehicle, and an economical autonomous unmanned diving machine by using a smart phone, and to provide a platform for the remotely-operated unmanned vehicle and the autonomous unmanned diving machine.SOLUTION: Interactive communication is established by accommodating a smart phone in an underwater pressure-proof vessel, receiving data from a GPS signal reception module and a short-range radio transmitter-receiver in an on-water pressure-proof vessel via an optical fiber cable 2 extended underwater, using the smart phone, and transmitting arbitrary data in the reverse path to above. Accessories carried by a diver are replaced by various kinds of functions of the system, and the number of the accessories carried by the diver is reduced. By incorporating a large number of optical receptacles for external control apparatuses, an economical platform for a remotely-operated unmanned vehicle and an autonomous unmanned diving machine are constituted.

title_en: unmanned navigation boat and unmanned navigation boat monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned navigation boat,andfurther discloses an unmanned navigation boatmonitoring method.The unmanned navigation boatcomprises a microprocessor, a power assembly, and a water quality sampling structure. The microprocessor comprises a driving module, a navigation module, a sampling module, and a distance sensing module; the distance sensing module comprises a distance sensor,the navigation module comprises a GPS locator, the driving module controls the power assembly, the power assembly comprises a side part driving mechanism and a rear driving mechanism, the navigation module communicates with a remote terminal and feeds back position information, and the sampling module controls the water quality sampling structure to collect marine samples; and after a plurality of sea area test points are selected, the driving module and the navigation module control an unmanned navigation boat to move to a designated point, and the sampling module collects a sample andthen collects in the next sea area test point. Sampling is conducted in the designated sea area by cooperating the driving module with the navigation module, the sampling module is used for driving the water quality sampling structure to sample, and the management and monitoring of an ocean is facilitated.
